course: Course 3: Programming in C and Python

chapters.title: How This Course Works, and Setting Up
chapters.objective: Explain why C and Python are taught side by side, what the course builds, and get a working C compiler and Python on any computer or phone.
chapters.c_focus: Install gcc or clang; compile and run a file.
chapters.python_focus: Install Python 3; run a file and the interactive prompt.
chapters.toughest: Diagnose a broken setup from its error messages.

chapters.title: Your First Program, and What Really Happens When It Runs
chapters.objective: Write, run and modify a first program in both languages, and follow it through the compiler and the interpreter down to the operating system.
chapters.c_focus: Preprocess, compile, assemble, link; main, return codes, argc and argv.
chapters.python_focus: Bytecode and the interpreter loop; sys.argv and exit codes.
chapters.toughest: Trace hello world from source text to a write system call.

chapters.title: Bits, Bytes and Number Systems
chapters.objective: Represent numbers and text in binary and hexadecimal, including negative numbers and characters.
chapters.c_focus: Fixed-width integers, two's complement, char and ASCII.
chapters.python_focus: Arbitrary-size int, bin/hex/int(), bytes and str encoding.
chapters.toughest: Prove two's complement arithmetic correct modulo 2^n; decode UTF-8 by hand.

chapters.title: Variables, Types and Memory
chapters.objective: Understand what a variable is in each language: a typed box in C, a name bound to an object in Python.
chapters.c_focus: Declarations, sizeof, integer overflow and limits.h.
chapters.python_focus: Names, objects, id() and dynamic typing.
chapters.toughest: Predict overflow behaviour; explain aliasing bugs in Python lists.

chapters.title: Expressions and Operators
chapters.objective: Evaluate any expression correctly in both languages, including the cases where they disagree.
chapters.c_focus: Precedence, integer division truncation, %, bitwise and logical operators, sequence points.
chapters.python_focus: Floor division, % with negatives, operator chaining, short-circuit values.
chapters.toughest: Explain -7 / 2 and -7 % 2 in both languages and prove each rule's invariant.

chapters.title: Input and Output
chapters.objective: Read and print data robustly, including fast input for contests.
chapters.c_focus: printf and scanf formats, return values, buffering.
chapters.python_focus: input(), print(), f-strings, sys.stdin for speed.
chapters.toughest: Read a million numbers within a contest time limit in both languages.

chapters.title: Floating Point: Why 0.1 + 0.2 Is Not 0.3
chapters.objective: Understand IEEE 754 numbers, rounding and their consequences.
chapters.toughest: Bound rounding error in a sum; find inputs where floating-point addition is not associative.

chapters.title: Decisions
chapters.objective: Write correct branching logic and know what each language treats as true.
chapters.c_focus: if, else, switch, the ternary operator.
chapters.toughest: Simplify complex conditions with Boolean algebra and prove equivalence.

chapters.title: Loops
chapters.objective: Repeat work correctly and reason about loops with invariants.
chapters.python_focus: while, for-in, range, enumerate, else on loops.
chapters.toughest: Prove loop correctness with invariants; avoid off-by-one errors systematically.

chapters.title: Functions
chapters.objective: Organise programs into functions and understand how arguments are passed.
chapters.c_focus: Prototypes, pass by value, returning values, the stack frame.
chapters.python_focus: def, default and keyword arguments, passing object references.
chapters.toughest: Predict the effect of mutating arguments in each language.

chapters.title: Recursion
chapters.objective: Think recursively, and know what recursion costs.
chapters.c_focus: The call stack, stack overflow, tail calls.
chapters.toughest: Convert recursion to iteration with an explicit stack; solve classic recursive puzzles.

chapters.title: Debugging and Testing Basics
chapters.objective: Find and fix bugs methodically.
chapters.toughest: Locate a bug by bisection; write tests that would have caught it.

chapters.title: Arrays and Lists
chapters.objective: Store and process sequences of values.
chapters.c_focus: Fixed-size arrays, indexing, bounds, arrays and functions.
chapters.python_focus: Lists, slicing, comprehensions, how lists grow.
chapters.toughest: Analyse amortised cost of list append; prefix sums and two-pointer techniques.

chapters.title: Strings and Text
chapters.objective: Work with text correctly, including Unicode.
chapters.c_focus: char arrays, the terminating zero, string.h.
chapters.python_focus: Immutable str, methods, Unicode and encodings.
chapters.toughest: Implement string matching (KMP) in both languages.

chapters.title: Grouping Data: Structs, Tuples, Dictionaries and Classes
chapters.objective: Model real things with compound data.
chapters.toughest: Design data layouts and compare memory use.

chapters.title: Files
chapters.objective: Read and write text and binary files safely.
chapters.python_focus: open, with, text and binary modes, csv.
chapters.toughest: Write and read a binary file format in both languages and check they agree byte for byte.

chapters.title: Pointers and References
chapters.objective: Understand addresses, pointers in C and references in Python.
chapters.toughest: Implement swap, linked structures and in-place algorithms with pointers.

chapters.title: Dynamic Memory
chapters.objective: Allocate memory at run time and release it correctly.
chapters.c_focus: malloc, calloc, realloc, free, leaks, valgrind.
chapters.python_focus: Reference counting and the garbage collector.
chapters.toughest: Build a growable array in C and compare it with Python's list growth.

chapters.title: Undefined Behaviour and Memory Safety
chapters.objective: Recognise the bugs that crash programs or open security holes.
chapters.c_focus: Buffer overflows, use after free, sanitizers.
chapters.python_focus: Why Python is memory-safe, and what it costs.
chapters.toughest: Find and fix memory bugs with AddressSanitizer; explain a classic exploit pattern conceptually.

chapters.title: Measuring Cost: Big-O and Timing
chapters.objective: Predict and measure how running time grows with input size.
chapters.toughest: Prove asymptotic bounds; design experiments that confirm them.

chapters.title: Searching and Sorting
chapters.objective: Implement and analyse the core searching and sorting algorithms.
chapters.c_focus: Binary search, merge sort, quicksort, qsort.
chapters.toughest: Prove the comparison-sort lower bound; contest problems built on binary search.

chapters.title: Linked Lists, Stacks and Queues
chapters.objective: Build linear data structures from scratch.
chapters.c_focus: Nodes and pointers, malloc per node.
chapters.toughest: Reverse, merge and detect cycles in linked lists; monotonic stacks.

chapters.title: Hash Tables
chapters.objective: Build a hash table and understand Python's dict.
chapters.c_focus: Open addressing and chaining in C.
chapters.toughest: Analyse expected cost under random hashing; anti-hash tests.

chapters.title: Trees and Heaps
chapters.objective: Represent hierarchical data and priority queues.
chapters.c_focus: Binary search trees, heaps with arrays.
chapters.toughest: Balanced-tree ideas; heap proofs; segment trees.

chapters.title: Graphs
chapters.objective: Model networks and search them.
chapters.c_focus: Adjacency lists in arrays, BFS, DFS.
chapters.python_focus: Dictionaries of lists, BFS, DFS, Dijkstra with heapq.
chapters.toughest: Shortest paths, topological sort and their correctness proofs.

chapters.title: Dynamic Programming
chapters.objective: Solve optimisation problems by reusing sub-results.
chapters.toughest: Olympiad DP problems with proofs of correctness.

chapters.title: Problem Solving for Contests
chapters.objective: A method for attacking unseen problems, from easy to olympiad.
chapters.python_focus: Fast Python techniques and their limits.
chapters.toughest: Full worked solutions to olympiad-style problems.

chapters.title: Modules, Headers and Packages
chapters.objective: Split programs across files and use libraries.
chapters.toughest: Design a small library with a clean interface in both languages.

chapters.title: Version Control with Git
chapters.objective: Track and share code professionally.
chapters.toughest: Branching, merging and resolving conflicts.

chapters.title: Testing Properly
chapters.objective: Write tests that catch bugs before users do.
chapters.toughest: Design a test plan for a numerical library.

chapters.title: Debuggers and Profilers
chapters.objective: Use professional tools to find bugs and slow spots.
chapters.toughest: Find a performance bottleneck in a real program.

chapters.title: Reading and Writing Clean Code
chapters.objective: Write code others can read, and read code others wrote.
chapters.toughest: Refactor a messy program safely.

chapters.title: Objects and Design
chapters.objective: Use object-oriented design where it helps.
chapters.c_focus: Objects in C with structs and function pointers.
chapters.toughest: Design a plugin system in both languages.

chapters.title: Complex Numbers in Code
chapters.objective: Compute with complex numbers in both languages.
chapters.python_focus: complex type, cmath, NumPy complex arrays.
chapters.toughest: Implement complex arithmetic and check it against Course 2's definitions.

chapters.title: Arrays at Scale: NumPy and C Arrays
chapters.objective: Work with large arrays efficiently.
chapters.toughest: Explain why vectorised NumPy is fast, in terms of C loops.

chapters.title: Linear Algebra in Code
chapters.objective: Multiply, solve and decompose matrices in code.
chapters.toughest: Implement Gaussian elimination and measure its error.

chapters.title: Random Numbers and Monte Carlo
chapters.objective: Simulate randomness correctly.
chapters.c_focus: rand and its limits, a simple generator.
chapters.toughest: Estimate pi and quantum measurement statistics; analyse Monte Carlo error.

chapters.title: Numerical Accuracy and Stability
chapters.objective: Keep numerical results trustworthy.
chapters.toughest: Choose stable formulas; analyse catastrophic cancellation.

chapters.title: Data and Plots
chapters.objective: Turn results into tables and charts.
chapters.toughest: Produce publication-quality plots from simulation data.

chapters.title: Bit Manipulation in Depth
chapters.objective: Use bitwise operations as a precise tool.
chapters.toughest: Bit tricks for subsets and Gray codes; olympiad bitmask problems.

chapters.title: How Memory Really Works
chapters.objective: Understand caches, alignment, stack and heap.
chapters.python_focus: What Python objects cost in memory.
chapters.toughest: Explain performance differences with the memory hierarchy.

chapters.title: Performance Engineering
chapters.objective: Make programs faster, with evidence.
chapters.toughest: Speed up a real program tenfold and explain each step.

chapters.title: Calling C from Python
chapters.objective: Combine Python's ease with C's speed.
chapters.toughest: Wrap a C library for Python safely.

chapters.title: Concurrency
chapters.objective: Do several things at once, safely.
chapters.toughest: Find and fix a race condition; parallelise a simulation.

chapters.title: Programming the Hardware
chapters.objective: See how C controls real electronics.
chapters.c_focus: Registers, bit masks, interrupts, embedded C.
chapters.python_focus: Python on microcontrollers and as a host tool.
chapters.toughest: Design firmware for a sensor with timing constraints.

chapters.title: A Qubit in Code
chapters.objective: Represent a qubit's state in both languages.
chapters.python_focus: Lists and NumPy arrays of complex numbers.
chapters.toughest: Check normalisation and measurement probabilities exactly.

chapters.title: Gates as Matrices: A One-Qubit Simulator
chapters.objective: Apply quantum gates in code.
chapters.toughest: Verify gate identities numerically and exactly.

chapters.title: Many Qubits: A State-Vector Simulator
chapters.objective: Simulate n qubits with tensor products and bit tricks.
chapters.toughest: Apply a gate to qubit k without building a 2^n x 2^n matrix.

chapters.title: Measurement and Sampling
chapters.objective: Sample measurement outcomes correctly.
chapters.toughest: Prove the sampler is correct and test it statistically.

chapters.title: A Fast Simulator: C Core, Python Front End
chapters.objective: Combine both languages into one fast simulator.
chapters.toughest: Benchmark against pure Python and NumPy.

chapters.title: From Your Simulator to Qiskit and Real Hardware
chapters.objective: Run the same circuits on Qiskit and IBM hardware.
chapters.toughest: Compare simulator, Qiskit and hardware results statistically.

chapters.title: Control Electronics and Firmware for Qubits
chapters.objective: See how classical code controls quantum hardware.
chapters.toughest: Design the control loop for a pulse sequence.

chapters.title: Capstone I: A Quantum Simulator Library
chapters.objective: Build, test and document a complete library in C with Python bindings.
chapters.toughest: A full project with tests and benchmarks.

chapters.title: Capstone II: Contributing to Open Source
chapters.objective: Make a real contribution to an open-source project.
chapters.toughest: A merged contribution.

chapters.title: Where to Go Next
chapters.objective: Careers, interviews and research software.
chapters.python_focus: Data, research and quantum software careers.
chapters.toughest: Plan your next year of learning.
